stakeholder.business-owner.title: Business Owner
stakeholder.business-owner.description: Represents business goals, funding, and expected outcomes for the API initiative.
stakeholder.api-program-owner.title: API Program Owner
stakeholder.api-program-owner.descriptio: Coordinates API portfolio practices, organizational alignment, and long-term API capability development.
stakeholder.api-product-owner.title: API Product Owner
stakeholder.api-product-owner.descriptio: Drives the API opportunity, prioritization, and product-level decisions across the lifecycle.
stakeholder.capability-owner.title: Capability owners
stakeholder.capability-owner.description: Responsible for defining, maintaining, and evolving the capabilities.
stakeholder.domain-specialist.title: Domain Expert
stakeholder.domain-specialist.descriptio: Brings deep knowledge of the business domain, concepts, rules, and constraints the API must reflect.
stakeholder.customer-specialist.title: Customer or Partner Representative
stakeholder.customer-specialist.descript: Contributes the business customer or partner perspective for the journey, value, and collaboration model.
stakeholder.api-consumer-specialist.desc: Represents the needs of developers, integrators, or other API consumers who use the API directly.
stakeholder.platform-architect.title: Platform Architect
stakeholder.platform-architect.descripti: Guides platform, integration, scalability, and architecture decisions that shape how the API is built and operated.
stakeholder.api-architect.title: API platform teams
stakeholder.api-architect.description: Responsible for designing and maintaining the API platform.
stakeholder.integration-architect.title: Solution architects
stakeholder.integration-architect.descri: Designs and implements integration solutions that connect the API with other systems.
stakeholder.platform-owner.title: Platform owners
stakeholder.platform-owner.description: Responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the platform.
stakeholder.api-designer.title: API Designer
stakeholder.api-designer.description: Shapes the API contract, interaction model, consistency, and usability of the exposed capabilities.
stakeholder.api-engineer.title: Delivery Engineer
stakeholder.api-engineer.description: Owns implementation, automation, testing, and release flow concerns needed to deliver the API reliably.
stakeholder.automation-owner.title: Automation owners
stakeholder.automation-owner.description: Responsible for the automation of processes and workflows related to business operations.
stakeholder.process-owner.title: Process owners
stakeholder.process-owner.description: Responsible for managing and improving the processes and workflows related to business operations.
stakeholder.automation-engineer.title: Automation teams
stakeholder.automation-engineer.descript: Responsible for implementing and maintaining automation solutions.
stakeholder.security-specialist.title: Security Specialist
stakeholder.security-specialist.descript: Ensures security risks, controls, and trust boundaries are addressed throughout the API lifecycle.
stakeholder.compliance-specialist.title: Compliance and Legal Specialist
stakeholder.compliance-specialist.descri: Clarifies legal, privacy, regulatory, and contractual requirements that affect the API.
stakeholder.governance-specialist.title: API Governance Owner
stakeholder.governance-specialist.descri: Represents review, audit, and organization-wide governance practices for API quality and conformity.
stakeholder.api-devrel-specialist.title: Documentation and DevRel Owner
stakeholder.api-devrel-specialist.descri: Owns onboarding content, developer communication, and documentation quality for API consumers.
stakeholder.operations-specialist.title: Support and Operations Owner
stakeholder.operations-specialist.descri: Represents runtime support, incident handling, observability, and operational readiness.
stakeholder.partner-specialist.title: Partner or Vendor Manager
stakeholder.partner-specialist.descripti: Coordinates external partner, supplier, or vendor relationships that influence API strategy and delivery.
